name: Sakura Taisen V Episode 0 ~Kouya no Samurai Musume~
original_name: サクラ大戦V EPISODE0 ～荒野のサムライ娘～
source: Sakura Taisen V: Episode 0 (STV-0) is a prelude to the full sequel, "Sakura Taisen V: Farewell My Love" (Episode 1).  In STV-0, you take the role of Texan cowgirl Gemini Sunrise as she rides her horse Rally across the American mainland from San Francisco to Washington DC.  Along the way,  Gemini defeats a legion of half-demon, half-robot "Japhkiel" from the evil sorcerer Patrick Hamilton, while protecting the targeted innocent girl Fuanita Cushing.  Hamilton previously appeared as a henchman of the president of the Douglas Stewart company in the anime "Sakura Taisen: The Movie"
translation: 《櫻花大戰V Episode 0～荒野的少女武士～》（STV-0）是本傳續作《櫻花大戰V～再見，吾愛～》（Episode 1）的前傳。在STV-0中，玩家將扮演來自德州的牛仔少女潔蜜妮．桑萊茲，騎著愛馬拉利橫穿美國大陸，從舊金山前往華盛頓特區。旅途中，潔蜜妮一邊保護成為目標的無辜少女芙娃妮妲．卡辛古，一邊擊敗邪惡魔法師派崔克．韓密爾頓麾下半惡魔、半機器人的「亞夫結」軍團。韓密爾頓曾在動畫《櫻花大戰 活動寫真》中作為道格拉斯．史都華特公司社長的手下登場。
